tickets.title: Authorization not working
tickets.description: I cannot log in to the application. Getting 401 errors.

messages.content: Why isn't authorization working? I keep getting 401 errors when trying to log in.
We're investigating the issue. Can you check if your API token is still valid?
I checked and the token seems valid. The issue started yesterday.

tickets.title: API rate limit exceeded
tickets.description: Getting rate limit errors when making API calls

messages.content: I'm getting rate limit errors. How can I increase my quota?
You can upgrade your plan or wait for the rate limit to reset. The limit resets every hour.

tickets.title: Feature request: Dark mode
tickets.description: Would like to have a dark mode option in the app

messages.content: Can you add a dark mode feature?
Thank you for the suggestion! We're considering this for a future release.

tickets.title: Database migration error
tickets.description: App crashes on startup after update. Getting database migration error.

messages.content: The app crashes immediately after updating. Error says database migration failed.
This is a known issue with version 8 migration. Try clearing app data and reinstalling.

tickets.title: MCP tools not working
tickets.description: MCP tools are not available in chat. Getting connection errors.

messages.content: I can't use MCP tools. The connection to MCP server keeps failing.
Please check if the MCP server is running and the URL is correct in Config.kt

tickets.title: Slow response times
tickets.description: Chat responses are very slow, taking 30+ seconds

messages.content: Why are responses so slow? Sometimes it takes over 30 seconds.
This can happen with large message history or when RAG is enabled. Try reducing message history length.
Thanks, that helped!

tickets.title: Token usage too high
tickets.description: API costs are very high due to excessive token usage

messages.content: My API costs are very high. How can I reduce token usage?
Enable message compression, reduce RAG context size, and limit message history. Check the settings screen.

tickets.title: Documentation question
tickets.description: Need help understanding the API documentation

messages.content: Can you explain how to use the search API?

tickets.title: Bug: Messages not saving
tickets.description: Chat messages are not being saved to the database

messages.content: My chat messages disappear after closing the app. They're not being saved.
We're looking into this database issue. Can you check your app permissions?

tickets.title: RAG search not working
tickets.description: RAG search returns no results even though documents are indexed

messages.content: RAG search is not finding any documents. I've indexed my docs but search returns empty.
Please verify that the vector database is properly initialized. Check the RAG pipeline logs.
